rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for physical pain or aching in the head.

example.english: I had a headache all day yesterday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 seng4 jat6 tau4 tung3

rows.note: Use this for an unpleasant nuisance or problem that causes trouble.

example.english: This pile of paperwork is such a headache that I couldn't sleep all night.
example.traditional: 呢堆文件真係麻煩，搞到我成晚瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi1 man4 gin6 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 seng4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6
